name: wakeonlan-mcp-server
description: Wake LAN machines with Wake-on-LAN magic packets from host profiles, then confirm they came up.

interface.shortDescription: Wake LAN machines with Wake-on-LAN magic packets from host profiles, then confirm they came up.
interface.longDescription: Wake a sleeping desktop, NAS, or lab machine by name and find out whether it came up. Hosts are profiles in the operator's config (MAC, address, broadcast, ports), so a call takes an alias rather than a raw MAC. A wake sends magic packets, then polls a TCP port such as SSH until the machine answers or the wait window ends. The server runs on a machine on the same LAN as the hosts it wakes.
